newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Petrogal, Aramco to meet in April to discuss stake.
newsitem.headline: Petrogal, Aramco to meet in April to discuss stake.

text.p: Officials from Saudi Aramco and Petrogal plan to meet early in April to discuss the possibility of the Saudi firm taking a stake in the Portuguese state oil company, a senior government official said.
Both sides will try to agree on a valuation for Petrogal after the Portuguese firm decided to seek a new technical valuation, Under-Secretary for Industry and Energy Jose Penedos told Reuters.
The meeting had initially been set for early March in Dhahran but was delayed at the request of Portuguese officials who were travelling with President Jorge Sampaio on an official visit to China.
"I hope the decision of the investment will be clarified in the first six months of this year," Penedos said.
He has said that Saudi Aramco could take a stake of up to 35 percent in Petrogal.
